compatibility_notes.playwright: Release changes proxy-auth scope, RFC 6265 cookie matching, navigation/action behavior and removes Node.js 20 from tested runtimes. A wrapper version must match its browser build.
compatibility_notes.patchright: v1.64.1 follows the matching upstream Playwright release; do not mix its driver with a different protocol version.
compatibility_notes.camoufox: The new release pairs the library and browser, reorganizes the repository into browser/python/typescript, changes GeoIP defaults, and fixes proxy credential encoding, virtual-display cleanup and default addon acquisition. Validate complete cleanup and bundled resources.
compatibility_notes.cloak: The newest stable browser is proprietary and requires an applicable license. Wrapper 0.7.0 changes license fallback/seat release and native geometry, and adds the fingerprint max-touch-points flag. No binary redistribution or license change is implied by this review. Wrapper 0.7.2, released on the review date, caps Playwright below 1.65 due to private API changes; native driver admission retains this backend-specific cap.
